tip.moveearth_addtional.advancements.bod: Open Advancements with L to see your next nation, industry, engineering, siege, and exploration goals.
tip.moveearth_addtional.nation_hub.title: Nation Hub
tip.moveearth_addtional.nation_hub.body: Nation, territory, and diplomacy controls are collected in the Nation Hub. Check Controls for its assigned key.
tip.moveearth_addtional.nation_applicati: Joining a nation needs its approval. Starting in the wilderness needs none. Track your application in the Nation Hub.
tip.moveearth_addtional.nation_roles.bod: Permissions for territory, diplomacy, and treasury actions depend on your nation role.
tip.moveearth_addtional.diplomacy.title: Diplomatic Relations
tip.moveearth_addtional.diplomacy.body: Attacks between allies never start a Siege, and nations under a peace truce cannot be attacked. Attacking a nation you have not declared hostile first asks you to confirm the war. Declaring hostility skips that prompt and allows unmanned cannon fire, bombing and Warnautics charges on its reinforced walls.
tip.moveearth_addtional.nameplates.title: Identification Nameplates
tip.moveearth_addtional.nameplates.body: Nation prefixes and colors help you identify allies, enemies, and neutral players quickly.
tip.moveearth_addtional.territory_core.b: Protect cores with a sealed reinforced shell. Exposed cores can take direct damage during a Siege.
tip.moveearth_addtional.reinforcement_we: Hold material in your off hand and scroll to switch between 1×1, 3×3, and 5×5 work areas.
tip.moveearth_addtional.reinforcement_cu: New reinforcement takes time to cure, makes audible construction noise, and gains HP gradually.
tip.moveearth_addtional.reinforcement_ov: Hold the welder and use the reinforcement-overlay key to find unreinforced blocks and leak causes.
tip.moveearth_addtional.upkeep.title: Territory Upkeep
tip.moveearth_addtional.upkeep.body: Long-term nonpayment disables reinforcement protection and core regeneration, and shrinks active territory.
tip.moveearth_addtional.territory_map.bo: Vanilla maps and Map Atlases can show territories, borders, and core locations using relation colors.
tip.moveearth_addtional.siege.title: Siege
tip.moveearth_addtional.siege.body: Hostile attacks on cores or reinforcement can start a Siege. Unaffiliated attackers act as individual forces.
tip.moveearth_addtional.siege_timer.body: A rolling Siege ends after 30 minutes without an effective hit. While attackers inside the defender's territory have dug, shot or been hit within the last 2 minutes, the timer stops, for up to 45 minutes per Siege.
tip.moveearth_addtional.counteroffensive: A fallen core can be retaken for 30 minutes. Defending members who stay within 12 blocks of it for 3 minutes in total, with no attackers present, take it back.
tip.moveearth_addtional.combat_logout.bo: Logging out while the combat timer runs kills you on the spot and drops your items. Wait for the timer to end before leaving.
tip.moveearth_addtional.prisoners.title: Prisoners and Escorting
tip.moveearth_addtional.prisoners.body: Restrain downed enemies during a Siege, escort them, and use a prison intake inside valid territory.
tip.moveearth_addtional.rest_healing.bod: Beds and normal campfires restore health from a shared allowance that refreshes periodically.
tip.moveearth_addtional.nation_income.bo: Jobs XP and TC, and Harvest Festival or Resource Find points, go only to active nation members. Not turning your view for 5 minutes counts as idle and stops them.
tip.moveearth_addtional.oxygen_depth.bod: Below Y0 the air runs out: without a gas mask and filter you die in about 12 seconds. Equip a mask and check its filter before digging deep.
tip.moveearth_addtional.local_chat.title: Chat Is Local
tip.moveearth_addtional.local_chat.body: Chat reaches only players within 100 blocks, and there is no nation chat. Use /msg <name> to reach someone far away.
tip.moveearth_addtional.industry_water_w: Your first Create power comes from water wheels. Natural rivers turn them harder than player-made flows. Wheels within 32 blocks share one output budget, so spread them out instead of packing them together.
tip.moveearth_addtional.industry_steam.b: Blaze burners, which heat steam engines, are a rare Warehouse raid reward (a bonus-slot draw). Fuel use follows the load; look at the boiler with goggles to see its coal use per minute.
tip.moveearth_addtional.industry_brass.b: Brass is mixed from copper and zinc in a mixer and basin. Without a blaze burner, a lit campfire directly under the basin counts as heat, for brass only.
tip.moveearth_addtional.industry_electri: The CEE converter is your entry to power networks. CEE alternators turn Create rotation into electricity, and the converter is also an ingredient of the first Mekanism machine.
tip.moveearth_addtional.industry_mekanis: The first Mekanism machine is the Metallurgic Infuser. Build it in a Create mechanical crafter from brass casings, precision mechanisms, an electron tube, an osmium ingot, a CEE converter and insulated wire.
tip.moveearth_addtional.wiki.title: Stuck? Check the Wiki
tip.moveearth_addtional.wiki.body: The MoveEarth wiki covers recipe progression and the nation and Siege rules.

moveearth_addtional.config.title: MoveEarth Settings
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.enabled: Magnify only inside the scope lens. The view around the lens keeps its normal field of view.
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.resolut: Resolution of the lens image as a share of the screen's. Higher is sharper but costs more frame time.
Smooths the lens image when its resolution is below the screen's. Off keeps sharp pixels.
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.interva: How often the lens is redrawn. Every redraw renders the whole world a second time, so "Every frame" roughly doubles world rendering cost while scoped. Skipping frames is lighter, but the lens image lags behind while you turn. Default: every 2 frames.
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.magnifi: Scopes at or above this magnification use PiP. Lower magnifications keep the usual full-screen zoom.
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.iris.de: Use PiP while an Iris shader pack is active. Untested; the image may break.
moveearth_addtional.config.scope.debug.d: While aiming, show the PiP state and why it is unavailable.
moveearth_addtional.config.hud.balance.d: Show your money balance in the top-right corner.
moveearth_addtional.config.hud.event.des: Show the running event's ranking and time left on the right edge.
moveearth_addtional.config.effects.shiel: Strength of the green flash when the MekaSuit heavy-hit shield blocks a hit. At 0% it is off; the action bar message still appears.
moveearth_addtional.config.effects.calm_: Stop the flickering VHS noise on the death screen and show a still screen instead.
moveearth_addtional.config.effects.reduc: Stop the title screen animation and meteor effects.
moveearth_addtional.config.audio.announc: Volume of the PvP announcer (first blood, kill streaks, match start and so on).
Volume of the chime that plays with server notices.

options.moveearth_addtional.upscale.mode: Experimental. SMAA smooths jagged edges. SMAA + FSR 1.0 renders the world at a lower resolution and upscales it, which is lighter but slightly softer. Hands and HUD stay at display resolution. Turn off if rendering breaks.
options.moveearth_addtional.upscale.edge: Depth: smooths only the outlines of blocks and objects; texture detail stays crisp and it is lighter. Brightness: SMAA default; texture detail also counts as edges, which is heavier and slightly softens textures.
options.moveearth_addtional.upscale.qual: World render resolution. Lower is lighter but blurrier.
options.moveearth_addtional.upscale.shar: How strongly edges are sharpened after upscaling. Too high makes textures shimmer. 0% skips the sharpening pass entirely: lighter, slightly softer.
options.moveearth_addtional.upscale.stat: Shows the state and resolutions at the top-left. Normally leave off.
